name: dsh-prompt-reverse
description: Reverse-engineer a usable prompt from an image: measure the style slots algorithmically (palette, contrast, temperature, sharpness, grain, exposure), let the caller fill the semantic slots with its own vision, and emit prompt + negative prompt + suggested parameters. | 反推图片提示词：风格槽用算法测（配色/对比/色温/锐度/颗粒/曝光），语义槽由调用方自己的视觉填，最后拼成 prompt + 负向 prompt + 建议参数。
author: 沈蓝
